Container.Name: meeting-summarizer
Container.Overview: Web UI for transcribing meeting recordings and generating polished meeting minutes using Whisper + Claude or Ollama. Upload an audio file, pick your committee, and get minutes in seconds.
Container.Description: Meeting Summarizer — transcribes audio recordings with distil-Whisper and generates structured meeting minutes via Claude API or a local Ollama model. Configure your own committees via the web UI; settings persist in the Data path.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Meeting Summarizer web interface.

Config.Name: HuggingFace Cache
Config.Description: Host path for Whisper model cache. Persists downloaded models across container restarts.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Host path for committee configuration (orgs.json). Committees added via the web UI are stored here and survive container updates.

Config.Name: Templates
Config.Description: Host path for YAML committee template files. Drop .yaml files here and use the Import button in the web UI to load them.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Your Anthropic API key for Claude-based minute generation. Leave blank to use Ollama instead.

Config.Name: Whisper URL
Config.Description: URL of your Whisper/speaches STT server. If it runs on another machine (e.g. a GPU rig), use that host's IP:port.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: URL of your Ollama server. If it runs on another machine (e.g. a GPU rig), use that host's IP:port.
